name: record-level-identifier
title: Record Level Identifier
description: An ltc:Identifier related to an ltc:RecordLevel.
rdfs:comment: This property refers to one or more related instances of the Identifier class. Every RecordLevel class must contain at least one Identifier, preferably a PID.

fields.name: recordLevel_fk
fields.title: Record Level (Foreign Key)
fields.comments: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the (Primary Key).
fields.rdfs:comment: A unique identifier for an ltc:RecordLevel.

fields.name: identifier_fk
fields.title: Identifier (Foreign Key)
fields.comments: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the (Primary Key).
fields.rdfs:comment: This property refers to one or more related instances of the Identifier class. Every RecordLevel class must contain at least one Identifier, preferably a PID.
